what: Review attempts dated November 12 to 15, 2026 (UTC) that were found in the retained records after the review census was closed. Counts per day only; no session, run or file identifiers.
limits: An attempt is one documented dispatch of a review task. Blocked attempts and attempts that returned an invalid report are included; this is not a count of completed reviews.
UTC days use recorded launch or CLI receipt clocks, client-session or decoded client clocks, and bounded panel-dispatch evidence; not every day comes from a measured invocation start.
The reviewer model actually used is not verified for every attempt, so the attempts are not split by family.
The collections are shown separately. Together they still do not establish a complete project-wide inventory or the number of provider requests; activity with no retained record is missing.
No grade, verdict or acceptance is taken from these attempts.

audit.by: independent metadata audit of the recovery table, 2026-11-15
audit.note: The audit files hold private identifiers and are not published.
